2607.21325.title: Toward cryptographically verifiable authorization for autonomous AI agents: A security hypothesis, preliminary formal model, and proof-of-concept implementation
2607.21325.paper_summary: Autonomous AI agents increasingly execute actions, invoke tools, and operate on protected resources with limited human oversight. Existing authentication and authorization mechanisms establish identity and delegate authority, but do not inherently provide cryptographic evidence that a concrete request issued by a specific agent satisfies the applicable policy in a specific execution context. This paper hypothesizes that agent authorization can be formalized as a cryptographically verifiable relation, denoted $R_{CVA}$, that jointly binds an agent principal, a concrete authorization request, an execution context, and the satisfaction of an applicable policy, while selectively preserving the confidentiality of private authorization attributes. We introduce a preliminary formal abstraction for Cryptographically Verifiable Agent Authorization (CVA), define a compact set of candidate security properties including authorization soundness, principal binding, request binding, policy binding, and replay resistance, and provide an executable zero-knowledge proof of concept that instantiates selected elements of the model over a Groth16 zk-SNARK construction. We further identify and formalize the structural separation among identity binding, authorization-request binding, and runtime execution binding as a central open problem in the design of secure agentic systems (a distinction {not explicitly addressed by} current agentic security frameworks) and present a falsifiable research agenda for its resolution.
2607.21325.paper_summary_zh: 自主AI代理越來越多地執行行動、調用工具，並在有限的人類監督下操作受保護的資源。現有的身份驗證和授權機制確立身份並委派權限，但並不固有地提供加密證據，證明特定代理發出的具體請求在特定執行上下文中滿足適用政策。本文假設代理授權可以形式化為一種加密可驗證的關係，記作 $R_{CVA}$，該關係共同約束代理主體、具體授權請求、執行上下文以及適用政策的滿足，同時選擇性地保護私有授權屬性的機密性。我們介紹了一個初步的形式抽象，用於加密可驗證代理授權（CVA），定義了一組緊湊的候選安全性屬性，包括授權健全性、主體綁定、請求綁定、政策綁定和重放抵抗，並提供了一個可執行的零知識概念證明，該證明在Groth16 zk-SNARK構造上實例化了模型的選定元素。我們進一步確定並形式化身份綁定、授權請求綁定和運行時執行綁定之間的結構性分離，作為設計安全代理系統中的一個中心開放問題（這一區別{未被當前的代理安全框架明確處理}），並提出了一個可檢驗的研究議程以解決該問題。
2607.21325.author: M. Llambí-Morillas et.al.
